ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/cream) pixels, with light pixels concentrated on the distal regions of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white regions are localized on the outer 25% of both lobes. The left lobe contains an irregular white patch with internal dark mottling. The right lobe contains a more expansive white region characterized by vertical dark striations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetrical V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 40 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge, with prominent peaks exceeding 15 pixels in amplitude on the upper-outer quadrants of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the leading edge sweeping upwards and outwards to sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme distal tips and intermittently along the upper trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel dark linear streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically through the high-intensity white region on the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips causing slight edge deformation.
other_distinctive_markers: Water droplet occlusion and spray artifacts present across the central and lower ventral surface.
